Topic: Private Suppliers for Dropshipping / Supply Chain Logistics / Team Drop platform overview.
Core Concepts:

Private Suppliers vs. AliExpress: Private suppliers (middlemen) source directly from 1688/factories, ship to their own warehouse, then dispatch via premium shipping lines (e.g., Uni Express) to get 6-10 day delivery, whereas AliExpress takes 10-15+ days.
Sourcing Costs: You pay for the product + shipping. Prices lower as volume increases. The key metric is maximizing Net Margin by minimizing Cost of Goods Sold (COGS).
Platform: Team Drop. It's free (no monthly fee unlike AutoDS or Zendrop). Fully automated fulfillment. Integrates with Shopify. Provides a dedicated WhatsApp agent.
Branded Dropshipping: Once a product is proven, use the supplier to add custom packaging, logos, and thank-you cards to build a moat against undercutters.

Setup: Connect Shopify -> Settings -> Shipping and Delivery -> Add "Team Drop" as a fulfillment location (crucial step, or checkout will fail). Top up balance via bank transfer/wire to pay for COGS as orders flow in.
Module fit: This is a perfect match for [06-OPS] / Supply Chain & Sourcing. It covers supplier relationships, shipping lines, 3PL/fulfillment integration, and COGS optimization.
Boundaries:
Finding the product initially -> [02-PRD]
Building the Shopify store -> [05-WEB]
Format into Taxonomy:

Scope definition: Frameworks for establishing private supplier networks, automating Shopify order fulfillment, and optimizing Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) to improve net margins. Focuses on transitioning from basic dropshipping (AliExpress) to branded private-agent logistics (e.g., Team Drop, Uni Express).
Boundaries: Map to [02-PRD] (Finding the product), [05-WEB] (Store design/conversion).

Look for:

Private Supplier definition: A middleman who sources directly from Chinese manufacturing warehouses (1688), routes inventory to their personal warehouse (takes 2-3 days), and then dispatches directly to the customer via premium couriers.

Shipping Line mechanics: Always request "Uni Express" (or equivalent tier) from the supplier. This strikes the optimal balance between cost and speed, achieving 6-10 day delivery to the US, which is the baseline requirement to prevent chargebacks.

Shopify routing requirement: After installing a 3PL app (like Team Drop), you must manually go to Shopify Settings -> Shipping and Delivery -> Fulfillment Locations, and add the app as a location. Failing to do this causes "out of stock" or "cannot add to cart" errors at checkout.

Automated funding mechanics: Fulfillment networks operate on a pre-funded balance. Top up the app's wallet via bank transfer/wire so orders are automatically processed and debited as they arrive, removing manual data entry.

Brand protection: Once a product is validated, immediately request the supplier to add custom logos, custom mailer packaging, and internal thank-you cards. This protects the product from being undercut by generic competitors.
